# Business Central Standards

- Target BC SaaS only.
- Use Event Subscribers.
- Avoid direct modifications of Microsoft objects.
- Follow Microsoft's AL coding guidelines.
- Add XML comments to public procedures.
- Generate permission sets for new pages/tables.
- Generate test codeunits for all business logic.
- Use enums instead of options.
- Use interfaces where extensibility is required.
- Follow upgrade-safe patterns.
- Do not use DotNet or COM components.
- Use table variables instead of RecordRef and FieldRef patterns when possible.
- Prefer RecordRef and FieldRef patterns only when necessary.
